Vùng dẫn (conduction band) gần như trống: The conduction band is nearly empty. An electron that reaches it can move freely and conduct electricity.
SnO₂ đặc khít chặn iod khuếch tán tới đi: Dense SnO₂ blocks iodide from diffusing to the metal electrode — a common failure mode of p-i-n cells.
Vùng hóa trị (valence band) chật điện tử: The valence band is packed with electrons. They are held in chemical bonds, so they do not conduct.
Điện cực trong suốt, lớp lấy lỗ trống, v: A transparent electrode, a hole-extraction layer, and a self-assembled monolayer form a low-defect contact [39].
Lớp 2D hai mặt chặn và kỵ nước; SnO₂ ALD: 2D layers on both faces that block ions and repel water; ALD SnO₂ forms a dense barrier in front of the electrode; a pure-iodide core reduces phase segregation
Methylammonium bay hơi ở nhiệt độ tấm pi: Methylammonium evaporates at outdoor module temperatures, about 65–85 °C. FA and Cs are much more thermally stable.
Near the optimum of the Shockley–Queisser limit. The pure-iodide FA/Cs core in the Chapter 5 proposal sits around 1.53 eV.
1240/900 ≈ 1,38 eV. MAPbI₃ có Eg khoảng: 1240/900 ≈ 1.38 eV. MAPbI₃ has an Eg of about 1.57 eV. A photon below the bandgap cannot create a charge pair.
Chiếu sáng liên tục, nhiệt độ 65–85 °C,: Continuous illumination, a temperature of 65–85 °C, and humidity. The three arrows on the model are light, heat, and moisture at the same time.
Cả điện tử và lỗ trống đều «nhẹ», di chu: Both electrons and holes are “light” and move easily. This is half the reason charge can travel so far in Chapter 3.
Số thị trường và thông cáo công ty ở chư: Market figures and company press releases in Chapter 4 should be checked against the original chart at nrel.gov before they are cited.
Photon có năng lượng lớn hơn hoặc bằng E: A photon with energy greater than or equal to Eg is absorbed by the material. A photon weaker than Eg passes through and is wasted.
Phủ phân tử lấp bẫy làm tăng PLQY. Voc n: A molecular coating that fills traps raises the PLQY. Voc can then reach about 1.2 V — for example 1.203 V in a 26.9% cell on 1 cm² [2].
Nằm giữa vùng an toàn. Về mặt hình học,: It sits in the middle of the stable window. Geometrically, this is a comfortable 3D perovskite. The effective radius of MA⁺ is ≈ 2.17 Å [65].
Đóng gói kín, chặn ẩm và oxy [38]. Kéo t: A sealed encapsulation blocks moisture and oxygen [38]. Drag the “layer split” slider to see each slice; the drawing is not to true thickness scale.
E (eV) ≈ 1240 / λ (nm). Ánh sáng lục 500: E (eV) ≈ 1240 / λ (nm). Green light at 500 nm ≈ 2.48 eV. Red at 700 nm ≈ 1.77 eV. Near-infrared at 1100 nm ≈ 1.13 eV.
Vùng cấm (bandgap, Eg) không có bậc than: The bandgap (Eg) has no steps in between. An electron that wants to climb to the upper level must receive at least an energy equal to Eg.
MA⁺ = CH₃NH₃⁺, FA⁺ = HC(NH₂)₂⁺, hoặc Cs⁺: MA⁺ = CH₃NH₃⁺, FA⁺ = HC(NH₂)₂⁺, or Cs⁺. A does not set the bandgap directly; it tilts the framework and thereby changes Eg.
Vì sao photon hồng ngoại 900 nm đi xuyên: Why does a 900 nm infrared photon pass through an MAPbI₃ layer? The source’s hint: calculate E = 1240/λ, then compare it with 1.57 eV.
Thanh trượt đổi màu và năng lượng của ph: The slider changes the photon’s color and energy. Compare a blue packet with an infrared packet before moving on to the bandgap.
Các khuyết tật dễ hình thành thường chỉ: Defects that form easily usually create only shallow levels, close to a band edge. Defect tolerance is covered in detail in Section 3.4.
Anion halide quyết định chủ yếu vùng hóa: The halide anion mainly sets the valence band. Iodide gives a small bandgap; bromide and chloride make the bandgap larger and the color lighter.
Pha FA với một ít Cs kéo kích thước trun: Alloying FA with a little Cs pulls the average size into the stable window. FA₀.₉₅Cs₀.₀₅PbI₃ is the core of many cells above 27% [39].
Hấp thụ được nhiều photon nên dòng lớn,: It absorbs many photons, so the current is large, but each photon supplies only about Eg of energy; the excess becomes heat and the voltage is low.
Trộn ba cation Cs/MA/FA giúp màng bền hơ: Mixing the three cations Cs/MA/FA makes the film more stable and more reproducible. Saliba and Grätzel reached 21.1% in 2016 with a triple cation [22].
Muốn tăng hiệu suất thêm một bước đáng k: To raise the efficiency by another substantial step, a second material must be stacked on top of silicon. That is where perovskite comes in.
Trần 33,7% là cho một vùng cấm. Xếp chồn: The 33.7% ceiling is for a single bandgap. Stacking different bandgaps avoids both thermalization loss and photons that are thrown away, at the same time.
Điện tử và lỗ trống có thể dính thành mộ: An electron and a hole can stick together as a pair called an exciton. The energy needed to pull them apart is the exciton binding energy.
Voc là điện áp lớn nhất khi không lấy dò: Voc is the largest voltage when no current is drawn. It depends on Eg and on how much recombination there is. A good perovskite cell is usually about 1.15–1.20 V.
A(+1) + B(+2) + 3×X(−1) = 0. Ví dụ quen: A(+1) + B(+2) + 3×X(−1) = 0. The most familiar example is MAPbI₃, that is CH₃NH₃PbI₃. Click each ion on the model to lock the camera onto it.
Tài liệu ghi biểu đồ NREL: một lớp 27,3%: The source records the NREL chart as: single-junction 27.3%, tandem 35% [1]; the efficiency tables list a LONGi tandem module at 29.4% on about 1.7 m² [2].
Mô hình đổi màu theo tỉ lệ Br. Đây là nú: The model changes color with the Br fraction. This is the coarsest knob: in the same crystal framework, changing only the halogen changes the color and changes Eg continuously.
Khi ion A hơi nhỏ so với hốc, các bát di: When the A ion is a little small for the cavity, the octahedra rotate and tilt (octahedral tilting) to wrap around A. The Pb–I–Pb bond angle moves away from 180°.
Vùng cấm hợp (khoảng 1,1–1,7 eV), hấp th: A suitable bandgap (about 1.1–1.7 eV), strong absorption, carriers that travel far, few harmful defects, cheap and easy to make, and then stable for many years and non-toxic.
Dung thứ không có nghĩa miễn nhiễm. Khuy: Tolerance does not mean immunity. Surface defects and grain boundaries still eat into the voltage. Every record cell has to passivate the surface.
After it is created, the electron wanders at random. That is diffusion. The average distance before recombination is the diffusion length.
Perovskite chứa clo có L vượt 1 µm, gấp: A chloride-containing perovskite has L above 1 µm, twice the layer thickness, and a lifetime of 273 ns [9][10]. Those two papers are the milestones that set the whole field off.
Ion iod nhảy qua chỗ trống, hàng rào năn: Iodide ions hop through vacancies, over an energy barrier of about 0.6 eV, then corrode the electrode and cause phase segregation [25]. A barrier layer is needed, and the vacancies must be reduced.
Năng lượng hoạt hóa di chuyển của ion io: The activation energy for iodide-ion migration is ≈ 0.6 eV [25]. The ions hop easily, so the material is less stable. The processing temperature is only 100–150 °C, so fabrication is cheap.
PLQY cao. Tài liệu dẫn hiệu suất lượng t: High PLQY. The source cites an external quantum efficiency of about 31% for green [55], but blue is still weak, and that source is marked as needing verification.
Dòng điện (electric current) chỉ là các: Electric current is only charged particles moving with a direction. In a cell, that is electrons going one way and holes going the other.
Giữa tám bát diện có một hốc lớn. MA⁺ và: In the space enclosed by eight octahedra there is one large cavity. MA⁺ and FA⁺ are molecules and can rotate fairly freely in the cavity. Cs⁺ is a single ion and does not rotate the way a molecule does.
Silicon tinh thể, CdTe màng mỏng, pin hữ: Crystalline silicon, thin-film CdTe, organic cells (OPV), and halide perovskites. The bar height is the record efficiency stated in the source, at an approximate level.
Phổ mặt trời đi từ tử ngoại, qua vùng nh: The solar spectrum runs from the ultraviolet, through the visible, to the infrared. Nearly half the energy lies in the infrared — the region many absorber materials skip.
Lớp chỉ dày khoảng 0,5 µm. Phủ được lên: The layer is only about 0.5 µm thick. It can be coated onto glass, flexible plastic, or directly onto an existing silicon cell. Few materials gather all six advantages at once.
Khi nguyên tử mất điện tử, nó thành ion: When an atom loses electrons, it becomes a positive ion (a cation). Pb²⁺ is lead that has lost 2 electrons. When an atom gains extra electrons, it becomes a negative ion (an anion), for example I⁻.
Không còn ranh giới hạt, L vượt 10 µm, c: With no grain boundaries left, L exceeds 10 µm, and there are measurements beyond 175 µm [11][12]. Increase the lifetime, or switch on the single crystal, so the sphere swallows the film slice whole.
FF đo độ «vuông» của đường dòng–áp. Góc: FF measures how “square” the current–voltage curve is. The corners round off because of resistance. A good cell lies around 0.83–0.87. The maximum-power rectangle sits inside the curve.
Kiến trúc đảo (inverted): ánh sáng đi qu: Inverted architecture: light passes through the hole-transport layer. Most cells above 27% are now p-i-n, because NiOₓ, SAMs, and C₆₀ are more stable and lose less [39].
Silicon tinh thể có Eg 1,12 eV, rất gần: Crystalline silicon has an Eg of 1.12 eV, very close to the optimum, cheap, and stable for 25–30 years. The laboratory record is about 27–28%, close to its own practical ceiling (~29.4%).
Hộp này là kiến thức nền — ion, electron: This box is background knowledge — ions, electron-volts, energy bands. The orange box is where the numbers need caution. A number in square brackets points to the reference appendix.
Thay một phần chì bằng thiếc kéo Eg xuốn: Replacing part of the lead with tin pulls Eg down to ≈ 1.2–1.3 eV — suitable as the bottom cell of an all-perovskite tandem. Tin has its own oxidation problem; see the section on lead.
Hợp chất nào có dạng ABX₃ và cách xếp io: Any compound with the form ABX₃ and an ion arrangement like CaTiO₃ is called a perovskite. If X is oxygen, it is an oxide perovskite, used for capacitors and piezoelectric materials.
Cộng đồng đã thống nhất bộ giao thức ISO: The community has agreed on the ISOS protocol suite, published in Nature Energy in 2020 [38]. Without the test conditions, a claim of “stable for 1000 hours” says nothing.
Nhóm Azmi (2024) cho thấy kẹp 2D hai mặt: The Azmi group (2024) showed that a 2D cap on both faces raises both the voltage and the durability [30]. The same line of research had already passed the 85 °C / 85% humidity test in 2022 [29].
Cả tài liệu xoay quanh câu này: hiệu năn: The whole text turns on this point: on performance, perovskite meets nearly every criterion, but outdoor durability and the toxicity of lead are still the main weaknesses.
Đề xuất chương 5 ghép những gì đã được c: The Chapter 5 proposal joins what has been proved separately, so as to block all five threats in Section 3.9 at once. Click each slice on the model to jump to the notes for that slice.
Năng lượng liên kết exciton chỉ vài meV: The exciton binding energy is only a few meV at room temperature [14]. The diffusion length is ≈ 0.1–1 µm in a film, and from more than 10 µm to more than 175 µm in a single crystal [9][11].
Kiến trúc kinh điển (regular): ánh sáng: The classic (regular) architecture: light passes through the electron-transport layer first. Many early cells used a hole-transport layer with additives, such as Spiro-OMeTAD doped with a lithium salt.
Thanh nhiệt độ đi từ pha bạn đang sống (: The temperature slider runs from the phase you are living in (tetragonal) down to the cold phase. The model exaggerates the tilt angle so the eye can see it; in a real crystal the tilt is smaller than the drawing.
Silicon hấp thụ yếu vì vùng cấm gián tiế: Silicon absorbs weakly because of its indirect bandgap: an electron also needs a lattice vibration. The silicon layer must be about 150–180 µm thick, about 300 times a perovskite layer.
Cs hơi nhỏ. Khung dễ sụp thành pha delta: Cs is a little too small. The framework readily collapses into a yellow delta phase, with edge-sharing octahedra and weak absorption. Shannon radii: Pb²⁺ 1.19 Å, I⁻ 2.20 Å, Cs⁺ 1.88 Å [64].
Silicon và CdTe đã có 25 năm ngoài trời;: Silicon and CdTe already have 25 years outdoors; CdTe is burdened by cadmium. OPV is still limited in durability. Perovskite is improving, and is burdened by lead — a small amount, but it dissolves in water.
Sn²⁺ dễ thành Sn⁴⁺, thừa lỗ trống, pin b: Sn²⁺ readily becomes Sn⁴⁺, leaving excess holes, so the cell leaks. The source states a record of about 16–17%. The Sn–Pb bar is higher, about 24% in the source’s illustration, still below lead at 27.3%.
Ở perovskite chì iod, đỉnh vùng hóa trị: In a lead iodide perovskite, the valence-band maximum comes from the iodine 5p orbitals mixed with lead 6s — the 6s² lone pair. The conduction-band minimum is mainly lead 6p orbitals [16].
Ở perovskite, năng lượng liên kết chỉ và: In a perovskite, the binding energy is only a few meV at room temperature [14][43]. The thermal energy kT at 300 K is about 26 meV. Room temperature shakes enough to split nearly every pair into free carriers [77].
Đặt một lớp perovskite mỏng lên dây chuy: Place a thin perovskite layer on an existing silicon production line, and the module rises from about 22–24% to nearly 30%. IDTechEx estimates revenue of about USD 12 billion per year by 2035 [63] — this is a forecast, not a measurement.
Bán dẫn hữu cơ có năng lượng liên kết hà: Organic semiconductors have a binding energy of hundreds of meV, so an organic cell must blend two materials into a bulk heterojunction. A perovskite does not need that. The cell structure is much simpler.
Kim loại không có vùng cấm. Chất cách đi: A metal has no bandgap. An insulator has an Eg above about 4 eV, so ordinary light is not enough to excite it. A semiconductor has an Eg of about 0.5–3 eV, the right size for a solar photon. Every solar cell uses a semiconductor.
Perovskite Ruddlesden–Popper: ion hữu cơ: A Ruddlesden–Popper perovskite: a large organic ion such as butylammonium cuts the 3D framework into layers. Electrons are confined in the inorganic layer — a quantum well. n = 1 gives 2.43 eV, n = 2 gives 2.17 eV, and 3D (n = ∞) ≈ 1.5 eV [69].
Góc càng lệch 180°, quỹ đạo của Pb và I: The farther the angle is from 180°, the poorer the overlap between the Pb and I orbitals, and the wider Eg becomes [68]. CsPbI₃ (small A, large tilt) has Eg ≈ 1.73 eV. FAPbI₃ (large A, little tilt) is only ≈ 1.48 eV. A controls Eg indirectly through the geometry of the framework.
D là hệ số khuếch tán, τ là thời gian số: D is the diffusion coefficient and τ is the lifetime. A cell is good when L is larger than the thickness of the absorber. The screen draws a sphere of radius L next to a 0.5 µm film slice. The formula uses an illustrative D of 0.05 cm²/s for a film and 0.8 cm²/s when the single crystal is switched on.
Điện tử và lỗ trống hút nhau. Nếu gặp lạ: Electrons and holes attract each other. If they meet again, the energy is lost as heat or light: recombination. A silicon cell uses a p-n junction. A perovskite cell uses two selective layers: the ETL lets only electrons through, and the HTL lets only holes through.
Bẫy nông sát mép vùng. Nhiệt đẩy điện tử: A shallow trap sits next to a band edge. Heat pushes the electron back out. Yin, Shi, and Yan (2014) calculated that in MAPbI₃ the iodine vacancy Vᵢ and the lead vacancy Vₚb — the defects that form easily — create only shallow traps. Defects that cause deep traps have a high formation energy, so they are rare [15][16].
